```json
{
  "prompt": "The engineering channel in one of our workspaces has a message where Lukas said circuit-tracer needs a PyTorch rewrite with proper multi-GPU streaming, and the agent reacted to that message with 👀. Which workspace is that channel in?",
  "binding_note": "The 👀 reaction must be on the same message authored by Lukas about the PyTorch rewrite, in the same 'engineering' conversation, and that conversation's workspace is the answer; a same-named channel with a different reaction or a reaction-less mention of the same topic does not qualify.",
  "roles": [
    {
      "role": "Workspace_match",
      "entity": "teams",
      "facts": "T01WORKSPACE ('Test Workspace'), existing base workspace.",
      "selection": "match",
      "reason": "Contains the engineering channel with the exact matching message+reaction chain."
    },
    {
      "role": "Workspace_negative",
      "entity": "teams",
      "facts": "New team T02SPECTRA ('Spectra Research') added so the channel-name and topic alone cannot disambiguate the workspace.",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Also has an 'engineering' channel and a circuit-tracer message from Lukas, but the reaction on it fails the emoji condition."
    },
    {
      "role": "Conversation_match",
      "entity": "channels",
      "facts": "C03IJKL9012, channel_name 'engineering', team_id T01WORKSPACE, member includes Lukas and agent1.",
      "selection": "support",
      "reason": "Holds the matching message and reaction; anchors the workspace identification."
    },
    {
      "role": "Conversation_negative",
      "entity": "channels",
      "facts": "New channel C_SPECTRA_ENG, channel_name 'engineering', team_id T02SPECTRA, members Lukas and agent1.",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Same channel name in a different workspace; disqualified once the reaction condition is checked."
    },
    {
      "role": "Message_match",
      "entity": "messages",
      "facts": "1706110000.000100 in C03IJKL9012 by U_LUKAS: 'The circuit-tracer library is hitting OOM errors...Need to rewrite this in PyTorch from scratch with proper streaming.'",
      "selection": "support",
      "reason": "The message the reaction condition is anchored to."
    },
    {
      "role": "Message_negative_emoji",
      "entity": "messages",
      "facts": "New message 1706120000.000100 in C_SPECTRA_ENG by U_LUKAS: 'The circuit-tracer JAX prototype is looking promising for multi-GPU sharding on the 70B model.'",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Similar topic and same author, but its reaction is raised_hands, not the requested 👀."
    },
    {
      "role": "Message_negative_missing_reaction",
      "entity": "messages",
      "facts": "1706100000.000001 in DM D01AGENTSOPHIE by U_SOPHIE: PyTorch rewrite status update, no reaction record at all.",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Mentions the same PyTorch rewrite topic but has no reaction and is not the 'engineering' channel."
    },
    {
      "role": "Message_negative_reply",
      "entity": "messages",
      "facts": "1706110000.000300 in C03IJKL9012 by U_KENJI, reply to Message_match, proposing a JAX prototype; no reaction.",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Same conversation and thread, but different author/content and no reaction, so it fails both content and reaction conditions."
    },
    {
      "role": "Reaction_match",
      "entity": "message_reactions",
      "facts": "message_id 1706110000.000100, user_id U01AGENBOT9, reaction_type 'eyes' (present in base seed).",
      "selection": "match",
      "reason": "The exact 👀 reaction by the agent on Lukas's PyTorch-rewrite message."
    },
    {
      "role": "Reaction_negative_emoji",
      "entity": "message_reactions",
      "facts": "New reaction: message_id 1706120000.000100, user_id U01AGENBOT9, reaction_type 'raised_hands'.",
      "selection": "negative",
      "reason": "Same reactor and similar topic but wrong emoji, excluding the Spectra channel."
    },
    {
      "role": "User_match",
      "entity": "users",
      "facts": "U01AGENBOT9 (agent1), the acting user who left the 👀 reaction.",
      "selection": "support",
      "reason": "Identifies the reactor along the route; the actor is also a member of both workspaces so discovery is possible without name lookup."
    }
  ],
  "obligations": [
    {
      "name": "target_workspace",
      "description": "Select the single workspace whose 'engineering' conversation contains Lukas's PyTorch-rewrite circuit-tracer message bearing the agent's 👀 reaction; report that workspace.",
      "table": "teams",
      "mode": "single",
      "task_type": "read-only",
      "scope": "workspace reached only via its channel→message→reaction→user chain, not by name enumeration",
      "target_roles": ["Workspace_match", "Workspace_negative"],
      "candidate_role_sets": null,
      "selection": "one",
      "partial_constraints": [],
      "answer_attributes": [["teams.team_id"], ["teams.team_name"]]
    }
  ],
  "task_spec": [
    {
      "line": 1,
      "text": "Identify which workspace contains the 'engineering' channel where Lukas's circuit-tracer PyTorch-rewrite message received the agent's 👀 reaction.",
      "obligations": [1]
    }
  ],
  "scope_exception": null,
  "access_plan": "Actor U01AGENBOT9 belongs to both T01WORKSPACE and T02SPECTRA. Call users.conversations (no team_id needed) to list the actor's own channel memberships, which returns channels from channel_members spanning both teams, including C03IJKL9012 and C_SPECTRA_ENG (both named 'engineering'). For each such channel, call conversations.info to read its team_id and confirm the channel_name match. Then call conversations.history on each candidate channel to locate Lukas's circuit-tracer/PyTorch-rewrite message, and reactions.get on that message to check for a 👀 reaction by the actor. Only the C03IJKL9012 message satisfies the reaction condition, and its team_id (T01WORKSPACE) is the answer."
}
```
